checks.name: Demo success is explicitly simulated with zero money collected and no stock deduction
Failed and cancelled demos create no orders and leave stock unchanged
Demo requires a valid attempt, supported method and customer login
Customer and admin both see demo label, while other shoppers cannot see the order
Repeating a successful attempt returns the same demo without duplicates
Concurrent retries from separate sessions create just one demo
Demo orders cannot be confirmed, shipped or assigned courier tracking
COD remains a real order and deducts stock despite forged demo/payment flags
